mapper.select: select user_id, email from user where email = #{email} and `password` = #{password}

select comm_id, comm_div, writer, title, content, like_cnt, dislike_cnt, ( select count(*) from comment a where a.comm_id = c.comm_id ) as comment_cnt from community c where writer = #{loginEmailId} order by save_date desc
select m.media_name, c.comment_id, c.media_id, c.content, c.assess_rate, c.save_date, c.update_date from media m, media_comment c where c.writer = #{emailId} and m.media_id = c.media_id
mapper.update: update media_comment set content = ifnull(#{content}, content), assess_rate = #{assess_rate}, update_date = date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') where comment_id = #{comment_id}
mapper.select: select vote_id from vote where comm_id = #{comm_id}
select world_id from world where comm_id = #{comm_id}
select comm.comm_div, comm.title, c.* from community comm, comment c where c.writer = #{emailId} and comm.comm_id = c.comm_id
